title: Amber Spire
content: Epic Treasure. When first revealed, draw 3 spells to attach to the spire. The base price of the amber spire is 5 + the price of the 3 attached spells. Each spell may be cast one time during Combat by placing a Might Cube and a Speed Cube on the amber spire, then remove the Spell Card from the game. The amber spire is not a Spell Book and spells attached to it may not be learned. No Magic Cubes are needed to cast these spells. Cubes may not be placed on other Weapon or Spell Cards when using this card.

title: Aquaria’s Enchiridion
content: Epic Treasure. This is a Spell Book for all game purposes that contains 6 spells.

title: Armageddon Hammer
content: Epic Treasure. Melee weapon. Optional might box on this card is automatically filled and does not count against the cube limit.

title: Ascendant Ornament
content: Epic Treasure. A purple Magic Cube placed on this treasure counts as a Might Cube on any might box on an active card of this Hero. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Band of Sagacity
content: Epic Treasure. A yellow Magic Cube placed on this treasure allows the Hero to reroll a Hit Die roll by or against them one time per Combat Round. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Bard’s Bouzouki
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero has +1 Cunning, Wisdom, and Charisma while equipped. The effects are cumulative with other Treasures.

title: Baton of the Lost Prince
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero has +1 matching respected icon during a Hire action. The effects are cumulative with other Treasures.

title: Belt of the Beast
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one Might Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Blade of the Scorpion
content: Epic Treasure. Melee weapon. Two optional might boxes, which may be filled in any order. A Might Cube placed in the final might box is placed in the Hero’s wounded box during the cleanup phase of Combat.

title: Book of Eternal Sand
content: Epic Treasure. This is a Spell Book for all game purposes that contains 6 spells.

title: Bow of the Hunt
content: Epic Treasure. Extra sharp. Ranged weapon.

title: Brogans of the Birds
content: Epic Treasure. May fly during Combat and once during the Action Phase each turn.

title: Canopic Jar
content:
Epic Treasure. There are two canopic jars in the game. Individually, they have no game effect (*Heroes still earn the reward for possessing an Epic Treasure*). If a single Hero equips both canopic jars at the same time, immediately discard both jars and select and record any revealed Civilization Location in the Adventure Journal.

Once per game, if that Hero would die or be removed, they instead place their Hero Chip in the recorded Civilization Location and do not die. They lose no Fame, spells, or possessions, including cards gained after finding the canopic jars, and all cubes become healthy. The Hero is undead for the remainder of the game.

title: Cape of Alteration
content: Epic Treasure. Healthy Might Cubes may only be placed in speed boxes. Healthy Speed Cubes may only be placed in might action boxes. *Remember: Might Cubes* *and boxes are red; Speed Cubes and boxes are brown.*

title: Codex of Cognition
content: Epic Treasure. May reroll one die during each Learn Action.

title: Coronet of the Lost Prince
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero has +1 matching respected icon during a Hire action. The effects are cumulative with other Treasures.

title: Dancing Sword
content: Epic Treasure. The attack speed of the Dancing Sword is always +1.

title: Dastanas of the Scorpion
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero may equip two one-handed weapons simultaneously. They may still only place cubes on one weapon per Combat Round, but may select either weapon each Combat Round.

title: Decimation
content: Epic Treasure. A black Magic Cube may be placed on Decimation to increase the damage delivered.

title: Earthen Cincture
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one green Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Elven Slippers
content: Epic Treasure. A green Magic Cube placed on this treasure increases maneuver speed by one. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Figurine of the Stalk
content:
Epic Treasure. Valuable. During the Challenge step of Combat, Monsters always challenge an unhidden Hero that possesses the figurine. spells and other Treasures take precedence over the figurine (*e.g. Alchemical Lure, Discord, etc.*).

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up  (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing and anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Fish Fluke Statuette
content: Epic Treasure. Only in play if using the Ruthless Riverlands Terrain Pack. May use ferries at a cost of 0 Gold.

title: Foci of the Spellcaster
content: Epic Treasure. May place one Magic Cube in a might box. This cube must come from the Hero’s healthy box and counts against the Combat Round limit.

title: Garb of the Gate
content: Epic Treasure. May move to any revealed Gate clearing paying normal movement costs as if connected by a path.

title: Golden Icon
content: Epic Treasure. Valuable.

title: Hand of the Lich
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero must wound one Action Cube each turn at the end of their Action Phase. The attack speed of all spells cast by this Hero is +1.

title: Helm of True Sight
content: Epic Treasure. May reroll any number of dice once during each Search Action.

title: Icon of the Dragon
content:
Epic Treasure. Valuable. During Monster Activation, it summons as if a Malevolent Mountain summoning symbol (*Juvenile Dragons*) and a Sound summoning symbol (*Adult Dragon*) are printed on the Map Tile, if not already present. Printed summoning symbols on the Map Tile summon normally. If the Malevolent Mountain and sound summoning symbols are already printed on the Map Tile, dragons are not summoned twice.

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up  (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing and anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Incanter’s Jewel
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one blue Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Jeweled Thief’s Skull
content: Epic Treasure. Valuable.

title: Kolah of the Horus’ Eye
content: Epic Treasure. Once per turn, may look at the top Treasure Card of a Treasure Site in the same clearing as the Hero.

title: Magewright’s Quill
content: Epic Treasure. May use a Learn Action to write a spell that the Hero has learned into a Spell Book. Spell Libram, or Spell Scroll. The Hero receives one cube that matches the banner color of the spell. If a universal spell, the Hero may choose any magic color. The spell is no longer known by the Hero and is placed with the Spell Book, Spell Libram, or Spell Scroll. The Hero does not earn any reward if they later relearn the spell using the Learn Action, but other Heroes may do so normally.

title: Magic Carpet
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero has Flying Ability. See Flying in the core game rulebook.

title: Magical Bowl of Mixing
content: Epic Treasure. A blue Magic Cube placed on this treasure permanently converts a single Magic Cube from one color to another color, in either direction, as shown.

title: Mirror of Idolatry
content:
Epic Treasure. The Hero may not take Sneak or Alert actions while possessing this card. Sneak or Alert actions taken prior to possession are not canceled.

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up  (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing and anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Mithral Chainmail
content: Epic Treasure. Armor. Cancels one sword. Lighter than normal chainmail.

title: Mithral Plate Armor
content: Epic Treasure. Armor. Cancels one sword. Lighter than normal plate armor.

title: Mithral Shield
content: Epic Treasure. Armor. Cancels one sword. Lighter than a normal shield.

title: Moon Mirror
content: Epic Treasure. May reroll either one of the numbered Summoning Dice once per turn. The effects apply only to the Hero’s clearing with the original die roll applying everywhere else.

title: Orb of Far Sight
content:
Epic Treasure. May perform a Search Action in any clearing in the current Map Tile or an adjacent Map Tile. Upon a successful search of an adjacent tile which has no Wilderness or Civilization Tokens in it, place a matching token(s) in the tile. The Hero may then look at the token and decide to place it face-down or face-up (*receiving LP and Fame rewards for revealing tokens, but not physical rewards*).

If playing using the Exploration rules, the Hero may explore as if in a Mountain Clearing regardless of the actual clearing type.

title: Ring of Malevolence
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one black Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Ring of Truth
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one white Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Robe of the Chanter
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one yellow Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Roc Egg
content: Epic Treasure. No effect other than being valuable.

title: Scepter of the Sorcerer
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one purple Magic Cube while the item is equipped.

title: Serpent Helm
content:
Epic Treasure. Armor. A Hero may attempt to hire any Monster with serpent in their name. There is no cost to pay for this hire, but the Hero must haggle 3 times in a row without rolling any door symbols. Any door result cancels the hire attempt and prevents the Hero from attempting to hire that individual Monster this turn. If the helm is destroyed, all hired serpents cancel their attacks and become unhired.

The serpent helm does not prevent unhired serpents from blocking  and attacking the wearer of the helm if the Hero is unhidden.

title: Shadow Cloak
content: Epic Treasure. Reroll any Hide reaction once per turn. Must reroll all dice.

title: Shaman’s Kaftan
content: Epic Treasure. Any Magic Cube placed on this treasure turns it into armor. If no Magic Cube is on the kaftan, then the kaftan is ignored and cannot be damaged. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Shield of Defiance
content: Epic Treasure. Armor. Armor value of 3. Weight of 2.

title: Shield of Mercy
content: Epic Treasure. This treasure may be used as a normal shield. If a white Magic Cube is placed on this treasure during a Combat Round, the Hero takes no wounds from any hits that are blocked by this shield, even if the shield is destroyed. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Shield of the Lost Prince
content: Epic Treasure. Armor. Armor value of 2. Weight of 2. Cancels 1 extra sword icon.

title: Staff of Thaumaturgy
content: Epic Treasure. Melee weapon. When the possessing Hero performs an enchant action, they may choose to enchant the staff of thaumaturgy instead of the Map Tile. Do not flip over the Map Tile. Place the chosen Magic Cube on the staff card instead. If the Magic Cube is later used in a box with a wound symbol or the staff of thaumaturgy is unequipped, the Magic Cube is discarded.

title: Staff of the Magi
content: Epic Treasure. The Hero may choose to ignore one wound symbol on a Spell Card.

title: Storm’s Eye
content:
Epic Treasure. No flying, swimming, or Ferry Movement within the Map Tile containing the Storm’s Eye. *Exception: If a Hero begins their Action Phase on a* *River Clearing, they may use normal Ferry Movement to move to the nearest Dock* *Clearing.*

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing and anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Summoning Marcation
content:
Epic Treasure. Valuable. During Monster Activation, it summons as if all Local Monster Die summoning icons printed on Map Tiles in adjacent tiles are also located in the Map Tile containing the Summoning Marcation.

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up  (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing. Anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Sword of the Lost Prince
content: Epic Treasure. Has a sword icon on two different might boxes. Valuable.

title: Sword of Torment
content: Epic Treasure. Extra sharp. The Hero must wound one unhealable Heart while this treasure is equipped. The Hero regains the Heart if the treasure is unequipped.

title: Tactician’s Grasp
content:
Epic Treasure. After tactics are revealed, but before attacks are processed (*Step 7* *of Combat*), the Hero may move one Speed Cube from attack speed to maneuver

speed or vice versa (*as long as there is an open speed box*). During the clean up phase of Combat, any moved cube is placed in the wounded box.

title: Tail of the Scorpion
content:
Epic Treasure. Only in play if using the Dreadful Deserts Terrain Pack. If the tail of the scorpion is in a Plains Clearing, that clearing is treated as if it was a Desert Clearing for all effects. *For example, non-Auroran Lineages ending their turn in the* *clearing would take a wound.*

Must always be face-up. If face-down and viewed by a Hero, it becomes active and is placed face-up  (*Treasure Pile, Merchant, etc.*). If its owner is killed, it is placed face-up in the clearing and anyone entering the clearing immediately takes possession.

title: Taper of Illumination
content: Epic Treasure. Do not lose an action when in a Cave Clearing on the Hero’s turn.

title: Trickster’s Stone
content: Epic Treasure. Receive one grey Magic Cube while the treasure is equipped.

title: Tricky Ring
content: Epic Treasure. A grey Magic Cube placed on this treasure increases the Hero’s attack speed by one. This card can have cubes placed on it in addition to other cards.

title: Wand of the Magician
content: Epic Treasure. When casting targeted spells, may reroll one or two Hit Dice on each Hit Dice roll.
